title: Chapter 1521 - 626: Willing to Yield
content:
Chapter 1521: Chapter 626: Willing to Yield

On one hand, the Snow-colored Girl·Hui possesses six arms, with Ning Zhuo assisting from the outside. The Flowing Gold Guest’s fists are hard-pressed to compete with six hands. Though his sound fork is powerful, it’s not his usual weapon.

"Impossible, impossible! How could I possibly not defeat even a single mechanical puppet?!"

The Flowing Gold Guest’s mentality was unbalanced, falling into a frenzy of rage.

He was determined to prove himself, resolutely clashing with the Snow-colored Girl·Hui, completely disregarding Ning Zhuo on the other side of the battlefield.

"It seems, I don’t need to use the Blood Ash Tinder?" Ning Zhuo felt a hint of surprise.

He glanced at the Blood Talisman Clone elsewhere.

The Blood Clone was engaged in back-and-forth combat with the Humbleheart Broken-Blade Guard. If Ning Zhuo were to unleash the Blood Ash Tinder at this moment, it would surely incinerate the clone completely.

But there was no need.

"It’s best to keep such trump cards reserved for emergencies."

The battle continued until the end.

The Flowing Gold Guest’s stamina dropped to its lowest, allowing the Snow-colored Girl·Hui to catch a flaw.

In the next moment, she acted with all six arms!

One palm sealed the shoulder.

One palm pressed the neck.

One palm jabbed the heart.

One palm clutched the wrist.

One palm struck the ribs.

The last palm, moving from below upwards, slapped the Flowing Gold Guest’s chin.

The Flowing Gold Guest staggered backward, his golden armor dented, golden blood flowing from the corner of his mouth, releasing the Chaotic String Split Sound Fork from his grip.

The Snow-colored Girl·Hui pinned the Flowing Gold Guest’s shoulder and neck with one hand, as the Ice-jade Hands emitted a bright light, and frost spread along the side of the neck.

The Flowing Gold Guest struggled a few times but could not break free, eventually half-kneeling on the ground, his body except for the head covered entirely in Mystic Ice.

Defeated!

The Flowing Gold Guest was defeated!

Lei Wangyue abruptly stood up.

Ye Qingming’s cup shattered under her slender jade fingers.

Jin Mantang’s facial fat twitched, and he immediately closed his eyes, covering his face. In the darkness, it seemed as if he saw a large sum of spirit stones and treasure thrown into the flames, burnt to ashes.

The Flowing Gold Guest’s expression was utterly desolate, glaring intensely at the Golden Core Puppet, the Snow-colored Girl·Hui.

Innate talent—the Ice-jade Hands.

The colorful armor on Snow-colored Girl·Hui returned to its original state, and the cracks and wounds on other parts of her body were also filled by Mystic Ice.

Repairing while fighting!

In terms of battle endurance, the performance of Snow-colored Girl·Hui in this battle was surprisingly equal to that of the Flowing Gold Guest.

Ning Zhuo sat steadily on the Green Forest Python Chariot, maintaining a distance from the Flowing Gold Guest.

"Flowing Gold Guest elder brother, do you still wish to fight?" He said aloud.

The gazes of countless spectators outside were focused on Ning Zhuo.

They saw this young genius, still dressed in spotless white, one hand playing the zither, surrounded by Mystic Armor, with a calm demeanor.

"Who would have thought the result of this battle would turn out like this!"

"I thought the Flowing Gold Guest was exceptionally formidable."

"Isn’t he formidable? His combat power is definitely at the peak among Golden Core Cultivators. Unfortunately, he encountered such a Golden Core Puppet."

"Don’t you feel that Ning Zhuo’s Golden Core Mechanism seems very exceptional?"

"Nonsense! A mechanism that could suppress the Flowing Gold Guest must naturally be exceptional."

"No, I mean, it seems so lively and lacking the rigidity of most mechanisms."

"That only indicates Ning Zhuo’s profound mastery in mechanical techniques."

"But when he controlled the Humbleheart Broken-Blade Guard, I didn’t get that feeling."

"Nonsense! The Humbleheart Broken-Blade Guard is an item of the Empty Valley Sound Green Mechanism Tube, how long has Ning Zhuo owned it? In this battle, he also showcased several mechanical techniques, which are part of that heritage. Isn’t he quite unfamiliar with them? Hmm..."

As the discussions reached this point, some cultivators realized and gasped.

"The fight was so intense, I hadn’t noticed. Apparently, Ning Zhuo spent most of the battle practicing rather than exerting full strength."

"With such a Golden Core Mechanism as a foundation, naturally he has a sufficient basis!"

"What is Ning Zhuo’s background exactly? To allow him to carry such a trump card. The crucial question is, does he have any more of such a card?"

At this moment, another undercurrent spread out, wherever it went, it stirred up a commotion and uproar among the crowd.

"Did you hear? This Golden Core level mechanical puppet is actually just a healing device!"

"What do you mean? Isn’t it a combat mechanism?"

"Hmm..."

"Hmm, hmm, hmm..."

The Red Robe Guest laughed aloud, his red robe flaring like a wave of fire. The rumors in the crowd regarding the Snow-colored Girl·Hui’s healing orientation were actually spread by him secretly.

Chun Yangzi’s eyes were radiant, reflecting Ning Zhuo’s silhouette in his pupils: "You indeed did not disappoint me."

The Nine Fire Dragon Lord let out a long breath carrying flames.

Tu Yuanzi remained seated, filled with joy on his face.

Ning Zhuo’s statement drew the eyes of the Flowing Gold Guest towards him.

The Flowing Gold Guest’s throat moved a few times, then he spoke in an extremely hoarse voice: "I... have lost. Kill me."

Ning Zhuo slowly shook his head: "Elder brother, when we fought, it was natural to speak harshly as part of strategy."

"But actually, both of us know we are pitiable people."

"I carry a heavy debt, exhausting my mind every day to find ways to repay it. As for you, you’re just being used, backed by various forces of Flowing Cloud Peak to attack me, trying to prevent Nanming Village from entering Flowing Cloud Peak."

"Previously, I challenged you twice, but it was only out of desperation, having no other choice."

"After today’s battle, I will no longer challenge you."

Saying this, Ning Zhuo stood up from the Green Forest Python Chariot and clasped his hands, saluting the Flowing Gold Guest.

Look!

What is the demeanor of the righteous path?

This is it!

Ning Zhuo’s words immediately earned him the favor of many passers-by.

The expressions of numerous cultivators from Flowing Cloud Peak were quite unpleasant, some looked as though they had lost their parents, while others twitched at the corners of their eyes, and some were red-faced with anger.
